description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Notifying that the decisions of the Wages Board for the Ruber Cuttivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade made under the Wages Boards Ordinance been approved and shall come into force on 01.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the approval and implementation of a decision by the Wages Board for the Rubber Cultivation and Raw Rubber Processing Trade, which constitutes a regulatory matter under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It establishes a new minimum overtime rate, making it a legal/regulatory instrument that modifies existing employment regulations.
